subject: MAP draft — traffic replay schedule & capacity ask
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acmebio.com>, Infra Team <infra-team@acmebio.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T15:23:00-08:00
Subject: MAP draft — traffic replay schedule & capacity ask

Thanks Tom — good call earlier. Attached is MAP_v0.3 (focused on the performance milestone). Below is a lean recap and the ask so we can lock the testing window and finalize capacity sizing. Please reply with confirmations or any corrections.

Summary (post-call):
- Goal: run full traffic replay of production session traces to validate peak latency, throughput, and cost estimates before committing to dedicated capacity.
- Target close for MAP: 2027-01-14 (sign-off on SLA and Dedicated sizing).

Proposed MAP milestones (milestone owners in parentheses):
1) Traffic profile confirmation — confirm list of replay segments, retention window, and anonymization (Owner: Acme Infra / Tom) — due 2026-12-17
2) Test window scheduling — agree weekend/off-peak dates for replay (Owner: Redwood / Logan + Rachel) — target 2026-12-28 to 2026-12-29
3) Dedicated capacity provisioned (staging) — GPU sizing & network prep (Owner: Redwood / infra eng) — target 2026-12-27
4) Smoke test & runbook dry-run — validate scripts, KV cache warmup (Owner: Marissa / Neha) — target 2026-12-28 (AM)
5) Full traffic replay & measurement — produce latency/cost report (Owner: Redwood + Acme) — 2026-12-28 (PM)

Key asks for scheduling/capacity: 
- Please confirm peak QPS (95p) and sample payload sizes for the replay.
- Confirm retention/anonymization constraints on traces.
- Approve tentative test window above or propose an alternative 72-hour window.
- If you want Dedicated capacity during replay, we need a formal confirmation by 2026-12-20 to reserve nodes.

Discussed ballpark sizing on the call: for the replay profile you described (spiky peaks, 6k QPS sustained for short bursts, average 1.2k QPS) we estimate a staging cluster of ~3 x A100-40GB-equivalent workers for comparable latency SLAs, subject to final profile. Rachel will provide a more formal calc.

Attachments: MAP_v0.3.pdf (MAP summary), traffic_profile_acme_replay.yaml (sample replay config).

Next steps: Please reply with confirmations for the three bullets above (peak QPS, anonymization, test window). If confirmed, Rachel will send an explicit capacity recommendation and Marissa will schedule the dry-run checklist.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acmebio.com>

Date: 2026-12-11T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft — traffic replay schedule & capacity ask

Thanks Logan — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed peak: our telemetry shows short-lived peaks to ~6,500 qps (95th) during campaign bursts; sustained peaks are ~4,500 qps. Average across the day is ~1,000–1,400 qps depending on region. Payload average ~850 tokens per request.
- Trace constraints: we can provide anonymized traces with IP/user hashes removed; PII stripped. Retention window for the demo dataset is 90 days. Any logs with patient identifiers (PHI) are redacted before export.
- Test window: Dec 28–29 works for us (prefer start 06:00 PT on the 28th). We can give a dedicated infra contact (infra-team@acmebio.com) to coordinate network access and IP allowlisting.

One ask: if Redwood recommends dedicated capacity for the replay, please include an estimate for peak-per-minute provisioning costs so we can include it in the procurement request. Also flag any DB or downstream rate-limiting we should temporarily disable during the test.

Tom Ellis
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme BioWorks
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acmebio.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-13T11:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft — traffic replay schedule & capacity ask

Great — thanks for the numbers, Tom. Based on the profile you've given (peak short bursts to 6.5k QPS, sustained ~4.5k), here's a conservative test plan and a quick sizing estimate we can lock pending the exact trace segmentation.

Proposed replay profile (summary):
- Spike template: 30s ramp to 6.5k qps with 3x minor spikes in a 10-minute window (matches campaign behavior).
- Sustained template: 45-minute sustained at 4.5k qps to validate heat/thermals, KV cache behavior.
- Payload: avg 850 tokens/request, 95th token size 1,600.

Sizing recommendation (staging cluster for parity with production latency targets):
- Initial staging: 4 x A100-40GB-equivalent workers, continuous autoscaler disabled for the run (we want fixed instances to measure steady-state).
- If you want headroom for extra parallelism during spikes, provision +1 worker (total 5) for the replay day.
- Network: set TCP window to recommended values in the runbook; we will provide the exact sysctl settings.

Cost note: Estimated incremental cost for a single 24-hour dedicated staging cluster with 4 workers on our Dedicated plan is approximately $6.5k–$8.2k (cloud/hardware dependent). We'll provide a more precise per-minute burn rate in the capacity confirmation doc.

Runbook highlights we'll execute (Marissa will lead the checklist during dry-run):
- Warm KV caches using a seeded prefix workload (~1 hour prior).
- Smoke tests for cold-start latency, then KV-warm latency gating.
- Confirm downstream rate-limits are disabled or throttling is set to high-water for the replay window.
- Collect perf artifacts (per-token latency, GPU utilization, p99/p95 latencies, tail-kv metrics).

Attachments: I attached a sample traffic_profile_acme_replay.yaml with the three templates. I'm also pushing a capacity_calc.csv to the HubSpot deal link.

If the Dec 28–29 window is final, I will: 1) lock compute reservations (deadline 2026-12-20), 2) send a per-minute cost estimate, and 3) ask Marissa to schedule the dry-run briefing.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks all — that gives us what we need to move forward. Final checklist / next actions (I will track in the MAP doc):
- Acme (Tom / infra-team): confirm anonymized traces delivery by 2026-12-17 and confirm start 06:00 PT on 2026-12-28
- Redwood (Rachel): deliver per-minute cost estimate and lock compute reservation by 2026-12-20
- Redwood (Marissa / Neha): publish dry-run checklist and run the smoke test on 2026-12-28 AM
- Joint: post-test artifacts and report due 2026-12-30; decision meeting to finalize Dedicated sizing by 2027-01-14

If anyone needs an earlier dry-run, say so and we'll shift. Otherwise we'll treat these as accepted and I'll update MAP_v0.3 with these milestones and owners.

Thanks — looking forward to the run.

Logan
